what: second blind read on the CURRENT complete witness set (Claude subagent, same family: blind, not independent), run to test the direction warning

disagreements.blind2_why: Paper spans: vital status 99.7% but only 96.8% completed a final visit, died or had a primary outcome, leaving about 3% with incomplete MACE ascertainment and no balance/sensitivity information.
disagreements.evidence_added_after: per-arm vital status bound AFTER this read: unavailable 12 (0.25%) vs 17 (0.36%) (FDA review of NDA 022341/S-027)

disagreements.blind2_why: Paper span: primary-outcome status known for only 3941/4076 (96.7%) though vital status 99.9%; the 3.3% with unknown MACE status has no by-arm balance or sensitivity analysis in the spans, so 'nearly all' cannot be confirmed and missingness could plausibly relate to events.
disagreements.evidence_added_after: NOT answered: the registry's COMPLETED milestone (42/36/23) reflects sponsor termination, not outcome ascertainment, so no held source gives per-arm primary-outcome status; the per-arm split is in the paper's Supplementary Appendix, which is not held

disagreements.blind2_why: Protocol span: independent CEC adjudicates all primary events, but no span states the adjudicators were blinded (4.3 NI) and MI/stroke adjudication involves judgement.
disagreements.evidence_added_after: committee blinding bound AFTER this read: 'adjudicated by an independent committee of physicians blinded to the study medication' (PMC7690176)
